pages.title: Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Manage food prep and order fulfillment using precise timing and ingredient combinations in this restaurant-themed simulation. Players assemble burgers and pizzas by selecting toppings and cooking methods through drag-and-drop controls, striving to serve customers quickly and accurately as customer complexity increases through levels. The challenge lies in multitasking different meal types while balancing speed and quality.

Key Features

• Ingredient selection and assembly  
• Drag-and-drop preparation controls  
• Increasing customer order complexity  
• Time management and multitasking challenge  
• Burger and pizza cooking mechanics

pages.title: Restaurant.io

• Casual dining-themed environment
